card.name: Linking words inside titles and headings
card.fires_on: Small linking words (including, during, with, and, that, an opening parenthesis) that come right after a noun phrase in a heading, title, or menu-like web text and join it to a following phrase.

modes.label: Connector in a heading
modes.description: A word like with, and, or during joins two parts of a title or section heading.
modes.example: 5.10 Drug Reaction<< with>> Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms

modes.label: Link word in web page clutter
modes.description: A linking word or punctuation mark in site navigation, captions, or taglines.
modes.example: Healthy food<< that>> tastes delicious too?
